messages:
Alex K: quick Q — getting a bunch of alerts for the model-serving stack that are routing to infra-oncall. Where should I look for traces/logs/metrics? also who can reroute PagerDuty if the mapping is wrong?

Morgan R: which alert ID or rule name? can you paste the PagerDuty link and the grafana panel if you have it?

Alex K: sure — PD incident https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345, alert rule name = model-serving-high-latency. grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/model-serving/_/panel-7

Priya S: ok—quick checklist: traces -> Tempo (https://tempo.redwood.com, search service=model-serving), logs -> Loki (https://loki.redwood.com, query `{job="model-serving"}`), metrics/dashboards -> Grafana (the link you pasted). PD routing: Alertmanager maps `alert.labels.service` -> PagerDuty service key. If the label doesn't match the service mapping, alerts fall back to infra.

Priya S: if you want a quick inspect, paste the alert's labels (from the alert payload). if it's a mapping issue we need to update ops/alerting/service-map.yml or change the label on the alert rule.

Alex K: payload excerpt: ```labels:
  job: model-serving
  service: model-service
  severity: page
```

Priya S: ah — that `service: model-service` vs our mapping expecting `model-serving` is the problem. small mismatch.

Sam P: I can do an emergency reroute on PagerDuty if needed (temp change the escalation policy). want me to point PD service `model-service` -> escalation `Model-Ops` now?

Alex K: yes please, PD12345 is active. would appreciate a temporary re-route while we fix the alertmanager config.

oncall-bot: Alert PD12345 automatically acknowledged by infra-oncall at 2025-06-12T14:02:11Z :white_check_mark:

Sam P: done — PD service `model-service` now points to escalation policy `Model-Ops` (temporary). I'll open a note and revert once config PR merges.

Priya S: plan to fix properly: update service-map key from `model-service` -> `model-serving` in ops-configs. PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood/ops-configs/pull/1123 — includes config diff and a 24h canary.

Morgan R: also recommend increasing the p95 threshold from 500ms -> 750ms for 24h canary to reduce noise during rollout. we can revert after telemetry stabilizes. :thumbsup:

Sam P: noted — temp reroute in place, will comment on PD incident and close when PR merged.

Alex K: thanks everyone — leaving traces/links here: Tempo trace example https://tempo.redwood.com/trace/abcd1234, logs query `{job=\"model-serving\"} |= \"latency\"`, grafana panel above. ping me if you need more. :pray:
